sentences.text: Even on previous occasions also i.e. on 15.10.2024, 14.03.2024, 19.01.2024, no one appeared on behalf of the respondent.

The present transfer petition has been filed by the petitioner with the prayer that Cr. Misc. Case No.2334/2021 titled as "Smt. Madhu Devi Vs. Smt. Mamta @ Bhumika", pending before the learned Addl. Chief Metropolitan Magistrate No.3, Jodhpur Metro, may be transferred to the court of Special Judicial Magistrate, (PCPNDT), Ajmer.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Addl. Chief Metropolitan Magistrate No.3, Jodhpur Metro
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner got married with Rohit Kumar on 28.11.2019.

After marriage, in-laws of the petitioner started harassing her mentally and physically for bringing less dowry and subsequently she was ousted from her [2024:RJ-JD:44684] (2 of 3)
[CRLTP-24/2022] matrimonial home and continuously harassed for extraneous reasons.
The petitioner has resorted to legal proceedings and filed a complaint under Sections 498A, 406 IPC against her in-laws.
She also filed a case under Domestic Violence and a case under Section 125 Cr.P.C. at Ajmer.

In counterblast, respondent (who is mother-in-law of the petitioner) filed a Smt. Mamta @ Bhumika vs Smt. Madhu Devi (2024:Rj-Jd:44684) on 6 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/120247527/
1 criminal case against the petitioner under Section 23 of Domestic Violence Act at Jodhpur.

entities.text: Smt. Mamta @ Bhumika vs Smt. Madhu Devi (2024:Rj-Jd:44684)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Counsel submits that being a lady living with old aged parents and having no source of income, it is very difficult for her to travel to Jodhpur from her residential place at Ajmer, therefore, it is prayed that Cr. Misc. Case No.2334/2021 may be transferred to the court of Special Judicial Magistrate,
(PCPNDT), Ajmer.
I have heard counsel for the petitioner and perused the material available on record.

The respondent (mother-in-law of the petitioner) has filed an application under Section 23 of Domestic Violence Act against the petitioner before the Addl. Chief Metropolitan Magistrate No.3,
Jodhpur but the petitioner is residing at Ajmer and she has also initiated criminal proceedings against her in-laws and husband at Ajmer.

entities.text:
Addl. Chief Metropolitan Magistrate No.3,
Jodhpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Further, this Court also transferred a case filed by the husband of the petitioner under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act from Family Court No.1,
Jodhpur to Family Court, Ajmer vide order dated 02.11.2022 passed in SB Civil Transfer Petition No.44/2022.
Looking to the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and the reasons mentioned in the transfer petition, this petition is allowed.

It is ordered that Cr. Misc. Case No.2334/2021 titled as "Smt. Madhu Devi Vs. Smt. Mamta @ Bhumika", pending before [2024:RJ-JD:44684] (3 of 3)
[CRLTP-24/2022] the learned Addl. Chief Metropolitan Magistrate No.3, Jodhpur Metro, be transferred to the court of Special Judicial Magistrate, (PCPNDT), Ajmer.
The ACMM No.3, Jodhpur is directed to send the record of the case to court of Special Judicial Magistrate, (PCPNDT), Ajmer.
Stay application also stands disposed of.
(MANOJ KUMAR GARG),J 145-MS/-
